description.en: SiliconFlow's OpenAI-compatible model service with account model discovery and balance display.
description.zh: 硅基流动的 OpenAI 兼容模型服务，含账号模型发现与余额显示。

description.en: Paste a SiliconFlow API key. Models are discovered from the API; a console cookie optionally refreshes cash and voucher balances.
description.zh: 粘贴硅基流动 API Key；模型从 API 自动发现，可选填写控制台 Cookie 刷新现金与代金券余额。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the full cookie block from the expense-bill page to refresh cash and voucher balances. Re-paste it when the session expires.
help_text.zh: 可选。从费用账单页面粘贴完整 Cookie，用于刷新现金与代金券余额；登录态过期后需重新粘贴。

help_text.en: Optional. Use the x-subject-id value from the expense-bill request when your console session has more than one subject.
help_text.zh: 可选。若控制台会话有多个主体，填写费用账单请求中的 x-subject-id。
